sourceOfTruth: Machine-readable task queue for active and upcoming agent work. Human-readable roadmap lives in docs/NEXT_STEPS.md.

tasks.summary: Fast-track replacement of Stone Library placeholder images using provided finish assets.
acceptance: Provided finish images are mapped and visible in Stone Library list/detail wherever matching keys exist.
Placeholder usage remains only for truly missing assets.
Residual unmapped finishes are recorded for the full image coverage task.

tasks.summary: Remove template/default assets and visible placeholder UI that block production handoff.
acceptance: No user-visible Vite/default app metadata remains.
No empty/placeholder icon containers remain in active UI.
Footer has no dead external social links.
External target=_blank links include rel=noopener noreferrer.

tasks.summary: Decide and document the image hosting strategy for current and delivery phases.
acceptance: Current-phase and delivery-phase image hosting policy is explicitly recorded.
Migration trigger and owner are documented.
If controlled hosting is selected now, migration work is converted into executable tasks.

tasks.summary: Harden GitHub Pages deployment reliability and credential safety.
acceptance: Deploy workflow does not depend on a personal PAT.
Lint/typecheck failures block deploy.
Manual redeploy is available from Actions.
Architecture/runbook docs reflect deployment contract.

tasks.summary: Reproduce approved Home, Our Story, Articles, and Contact Us UI from Figma and WordPress references.
acceptance: Target pages reach agreed parity versus approved references.
Responsive parity is checked on desktop and mobile.
Before/after evidence and gap list are captured in worklog.

tasks.summary: Define and stage Sample Request capability for later implementation.
acceptance: Implementation path is documented with constraints and owner.
Route and CTA behavior are explicit and non-broken before backend approval.
Follow-up build task has implementation-ready acceptance criteria.

tasks.summary: Complete Stone Library finish imagery coverage after fast-track ingestion.
acceptance: All priority stones/finishes display intended HD images in list and detail views.
No approved finish remains on placeholder imagery.

tasks.summary: Define and implement how secondary finish frames should be shown.
acceptance: Secondary image behavior is documented and implemented with clear trigger rules.
Desktop and mobile interactions keep active finish state synchronized.
Missing secondary assets degrade to the primary frame without placeholder regression.

tasks.summary: Replace generic finish behavior text with approved product/engineering notes.
acceptance: Finish behavior notes are reviewed and specific enough for designer decision support.
Wording remains non-absolute and context-safe.

tasks.summary: Unify project list/detail data source to prevent drift.
acceptance: List and detail pages use one shared typed data source.
No duplicated project metadata blocks remain.

tasks.summary: Decide and implement final GitHub Pages routing strategy with explicit SEO tradeoff.
acceptance: Routing strategy is explicitly chosen, implemented, and documented.
No refresh 404 regressions occur for declared routes under Pages hosting.
SEO/URL tradeoff is visible in handoff docs.

tasks.summary: Align homepage feature modules with brand baseline pillars and proof framing.
acceptance: Homepage modules map cleanly to brand pillars and evidence framing.
Design alignment is reviewed against docs/DESIGN.md.

tasks.summary: Reduce client bundle size and improve chunk strategy.
acceptance: Large chunk warning is reduced or documented with a deliberate split strategy.
Route-level lazy loading is evaluated.

tasks.summary: Add automated route smoke coverage for declared routes and key CTAs.
acceptance: Declared routes and key CTAs are covered by automated smoke checks.
Smoke failures produce actionable route names.
